items.mnemonic: あ: a stretching figure: the cross on top is the head and arms, the big loop below is the belly. It lets out a long, satisfied 'Ahh!'
い: two short strokes side by side, like two EEls swimming up a stream — the left one longer, both saying 'ee'.
か: a KAtana slicing down on the left while a chip of steel flies off to the right — the sharp 'ka!' of the strike.
が: か with two dots (the dakuten) at the top right. The dots turn the sharp 'ka' into a deep 'ga', like a GAvel banging twice.
